summary: This bill amends the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938 to specify that tasks and services performed by students as part of their required curriculum at postsecondary vocational institutions are not considered employment, thereby exempting them from minimum wage and overtime protections.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Fair Labor Standards Act to exclude vocational students performing required tasks from the definition of 'employee.' This directly reduces the scope of labor protections for these individuals, shifting power towards educational institutions and potentially limiting their ability to organize or demand fair wages under FLSA.
